digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend adapter seam and architecture documentation
propositions: ADR 0035 must be amended to record the jira_family sub-seam layer, two parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel), shared jira provenance, and the March 2029 DC read-only horizon with deferred generalization to epic be74

The backend contract suite certifies a backend only if the port is complete and typed; the DC port declares six TicketTransport members while the core reaches for twenty-one distinct transport members, with twelve absent and unannotated parameters preventing mypy enforcement
RemoteRef.instance is intended design never constructed in production code; the ADR must state this as a gap rather than asserting deployments are distinguished by it

Three stale statements in ADR 0035 falsely claim the first real second backend is out of scope: the layout diagram comment, prose section, and Decision item 6 must all be corrected since this epic landed Jira Data Center ahead of GitHub adapter be74

Documentation must record least-privilege PAT scoping, allow_insecure, ca_bundle, and resolved_statuses configuration; the documented commands must execute successfully against a real Jira Data Center instance
